test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 09 May 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Rangarajan Committee is associated with ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Estimation of poverty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Rangarajan Committee **was formed in 2012 by the Government of India to estimate poverty levels in the country.
 
• The committee was headed by **former Reserve Bank of India Governor, C. Rangarajan**.
 
• The committee used the Tendulkar methodology to estimate poverty levels, which includes factors like calorie consumption, health and education expenses, and other basic needs.
 
• The committee's report stated that poverty levels in India had declined from 37.2% in 2004-05 to 29.5% in 2012.
 
• The report was criticized by some for using a low poverty line and not taking into account regional variations in the cost of living.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• Election reforms - There have been many committees and commissions formed in India to suggest reforms in the electoral process, including the Dinesh Goswami Committee, the Indrajit Gupta Committee, and the Law Commission of India.
 
• Educational reform - There have also been many committees formed to suggest reforms in the education sector, including the Yash Pal Committee, the TSR Subramanian Committee, and the Kothari Commission.
 
• Environmental protection - There have been various committees and commissions formed to address environmental issues in India, including the National Green Tribunal, the Bhure Lal Committee, and the Madhav Gadgil Committee.
 
• Estimation of poverty - As discussed above, the Rangarajan Committee was formed specifically to estimate poverty levels in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hence, the statement is that the Rangarajan Committee is associated with the estimation of poverty, which is correct.
 
• The committee was formed in 2012 by the Government of India to estimate poverty levels in the country using the Tendulkar methodology.
 
• The committee's report stated that poverty levels in India had declined from 37.2% in 2004-05 to 29.5% in 2012.
